summary: Bomb blast case; Lajpat Nagar market attack; 13 deaths; conspiracy; confirmation of death sentence references; commutation of death penalty for A3 due to delay in execution; acquittal confirmed for A5, A6; life imprisonment upheld for A9; appeal against conviction by State dismissed; prosecution evidence standards: reliable disclosures, corroboration; High Court partial acquittals affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Explosive Substances Act, s. 4 r/w s. 5
final_judgment: Death sentence commuted to life for A3; acquittals upheld for A5 and A6; life sentence confirmed for A9; State's appeal for reversal of High Court judgment dismissed.
